title: Industrial Robot
summary: A school-team robotics project exploring drink dispensing and Arduino-based command signalling.
content:
Our group at WWG Bayreuth worked on an industrial robot intended to dispense drinks at the press of a button.

Connecting microelectronics

The project also explored communication with an Arduino. A relay transmits Morse-coded commands to the industrial robot, providing an interface for extending its functions with microelectronics.

This was a group project. The public source documents the system and interface, rather than assigning every component to an individual contributor.
